system.name: DPA-OMF
system.one_liner: Aligns a pre-trained multi-agent traffic simulation model by ranking its own rollouts against expert demos with occupancy measure matching, then applying direct preference alignment.

content.variant_note: a loop of sample rollouts, rank them against an expert demo, align the model; three coloured section headings, the model with distribution curves at the left and a mini grid of scenes and heat maps at the right
content.argues: Expert demonstrations can rank the model's own rollouts through occupancy measure matching, giving implicit preference pairs at scale to align a motion generation model directly.
content.subject: Motion token prediction model, rollout database, a ranking grid of expert demo, sampled rollouts and heat maps, and the preference objective that closes the loop.

summary: This paper aligns a pre-trained multi-agent traffic simulation model with human preferences without human rankings: expert demonstrations rank the model's own rollouts through occupancy measure matching, and the ranked pairs drive a direct preference alignment (DPA-OMF). Figure 1 draws a loop in three coloured sections. At the left a scene encoder feeds a motion token prediction model, with distributions drawn as orange curves over grey dotted reference curves and token chips below. A grey arrow samples rollouts into a database and an orange arrow returns them for alignment, under the objective max P(green > red | c). At the right, an expert demo and two sampled rollouts with heat maps, check and cross marks show the ranking.
summary_zh: 论文无需人工排序，用专家示范通过占用度量匹配给预训练交通仿真模型自己的采样排序，再做直接偏好对齐（DPA-OMF）。图1分三块着色区域画出采样入库、热图加对勾叉号排序、橙色箭头回灌对齐的循环。
notes: Prior kinds kept. The three coloured headings are counted as titled panels although they are not framed and the loop arrows cross between them. The meaning of the two heat maps (occupancy features of the rollouts compared with the expert demo) follows the caption; the figure itself only places them above the rollouts. The database and scene icons are unlabelled. Medium of the small icons is a best reading of the digest (10 bitmaps, 146 vector paths). The schema has no marker kind for check, cross and the preference sign, recorded as other.
